#!/bin/sh
exec sbcl --script check.lisp
---
(defun read-forms (path)
  (with-open-file (in path)
    (loop for form = (read in nil in) until (eq form in) collect form)))

(defun fail (why) (format t "FAIL: ~a~%" why) (sb-ext:exit :code 1))

(let* ((forms (handler-case (read-forms "report.lisp")
                (error (c) (fail (format nil "report.lisp does not read: ~a" c)))))
       (defun-form (find-if (lambda (f) (and (consp f) (eq (first f) 'defun))) forms))
       (wof (first (cdddr defun-form)))
       (let*-form (first (cddr wof))))
  (unless (and (consp wof) (eq (first wof) 'with-open-file)) (fail "with-open-file is gone"))
  (unless (and (consp let*-form) (eq (first let*-form) 'let*)) (fail "the let* is gone"))
  (let ((bindings (second let*-form)))
    (unless (= 4 (length bindings)) (fail (format nil "~d bindings, want 4" (length bindings))))
    (unless (equal (first bindings) '(title (read-line stream))) (fail "binding 1 changed"))
    (unless (equal (second bindings) '(header (read-line stream)))
      (fail (format nil "binding 2 is ~s, want (header (read-line stream))" (second bindings))))
    (unless (equal (third bindings) '(width (length header)))
      (fail (format nil "binding 3 is ~s, want (width (length header))" (third bindings))))
    (unless (equal (fourth bindings) '(count (parse-integer (read-line stream))))
      (fail "the count binding must remain last and unchanged")))
  (unless (equal (cddr let*-form) '((list :title title :count count)))
    (fail "the let* body changed")))
(format t "ok~%")

In my edit I used `           (title (read-line stream))` — that's 11 spaces. Hmm, that should match the title line which has 11 spaces after the let*... wait no. The title binding is on the same line as `(let*`? Actually looking at line 1: `    (let* ((title (read-line stream))` — title is on the same line as let*. So there's no line starting with `(title`. That's why my match failed.

So I need to split that. The bindings start on the same line: `(let* ((title (read-line stream))` then next line `(count ...)`. I need to insert the two new bindings between. I'll replace:

`    (let* ((title (read-line stream))\n           (count (parse-integer (read-line stream))))`

with:

`    (let* ((title (read-line stream))\n           (header (read-line stream))\n           (width (length header))\n           (count (parse-integer (read-line stream))))`
